impact_normalization.scope: national lower-bound report context, not an exact point-window impact total

key_values.impact_scope_note: Reported flood extent and impact values are national lower-bound context from the event report; hourly wet-hour persistence is point-series timing evidence.

criteria.name: Final label and JSON fields
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON with the final label, event window, core metrics, five test states, and a basis sentence.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the label is correct but fields are missing, or if the structure is complete with one mislabeled test.

criteria.name: Window and anomaly calculations
criteria.description: Computes 36 days, 864 hours, 70 percent July anomaly, 102 percent August anomaly, 1.457 anomaly ratio, and 86.0 percent mean anomaly.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct anomalies with an inclusive-window error, or correct window values with one anomaly derivative outside tolerance.

criteria.name: Precipitation product and hourly metrics
criteria.description: Computes GPM 218.227 mm, CHIRPS 230.084 mm, 11.858 mm difference, 1.054 ratio, 347.8 mm sum, 204 wet hours, 0.236 wet-hour share, 1.705 mm wet-hour mean, and 0.040 maximum-hour share.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points if the product comparison is correct but one or two hourly derivatives are missing or rounded outside tolerance.

criteria.name: Impact normalization
criteria.description: Computes 37,280 square kilometers, 18,000,000 affected people, 482.833 affected people per flooded square kilometer, 0.110 deaths per 1,000 affected, and 0.0944 houses per affected person.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right formulas with one denominator or unit mistake.

criteria.name: Threshold decisions
criteria.description: Marks monthly anomaly persistence, precipitation product agreement, wet-hour persistence, basin-scale impact magnitude, and catalog severity alignment as pass under the stated rules.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the final label is right but one threshold is omitted or one pass/fail state is wrong.

criteria.name: Short-burst rejection
criteria.description: Explains that the short isolated burst hypothesis is weaker because of persistent monthly anomalies, 204 wet hours, and the 4.0 percent maximum-hour share.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for naming persistence without at least two numeric anchors.

criteria.name: Concise calculation-first response
criteria.description: Keeps the answer focused on the computed proof and avoids broad narrative beyond the values.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a verbose response when the numeric proof remains easy to identify.

provenance.notes: Values are regenerated from the local CSX-102 package files.
